title: The Portrait of the Bell House
author: Juniper Marchetti
blurb: Ada Ravensworth, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, has spent fifteen years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must learn the song's last verse without singing along before the last resident signs the papers.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
